## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō zhǎngzhě zǐ àonǎo sān chù jīng* (T525) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Ān Shìgāo 安世高 ([安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98)). It opens the long sub-cycle of "elder's son" (*zhǎngzhě zǐ* 長者子, Sanskrit *gṛhapati-putra*) sūtras ([KR6i0155](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0155)–0181) — narratives about the children of wealthy lay-merchants who become Buddhist devotees.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative on the karmic vexations (*àonǎo* 懊惱) of an elder's son in three successive places (rebirths). Translation falls within Ān Shìgāo's productive period (148–170 CE).
